description: baseline: LightGBM (Optuna-tuned, 5-fold CV) + CatBoost ensemble for a 100-sample binary tabular task — GBMs are the correct choice at N=100 and CatBoost's native categorical handling suits the 5 categorical columns

Titanic domain feature engineering (extract Title from Name, FamilySize, IsAlone, CabinKnown flag, Fare log-transform, drop ID/high-cardinality cols) + smoothed target encoding for categoricals + XGBoost and LogisticRegression added to ensemble; fixed StringDtype cat_col detection for pandas parquet loading

Enhanced feature engineering (Age imputed by Title+Pclass group medians, added Deck, IsChild, AgeBin, FarePerPerson, Age_Pclass, Pclass_Sex, FamilySizeGroup features) + expanded ensemble with SVM (RBF), Random Forest, and Extra Trees + rank-average ensemble to push from 0.979167 toward perfect AUC on the 20-sample val set.
